verdict.rationale: A probe of the sources help page documents a choice between Deep Research and Fast Research modes for gathering web sources, which lets a researcher set depth and effort before a run. Separately, chat lets users select which sources the model draws on, which gives some control over scope. Nothing shows the user can adjust a run while it executes, and the depth control rests on a single probe summary rather than detailed docs. Missing for 10: mid-run steering or redirection, explicit scope controls for the research run itself (domains, source count, time budget), in-depth first-party documentation of the research modes, and independent hands-on corroboration.
